mediaWork.title: The Witness
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Follows Bill Genovese, brother of murder victim Kitty Genovese, as he investigates her 1964 murder decades later. Critically re-examines the famous "38 witnesses watched and did nothing" narrative (the bystander effect) popularized by The New York Times. Explores the lasting trauma on the victim's family and the search for truth behind a crime myth.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: In 1964, Kitty Genovese was repeatedly stabbed on a street in Queens, New York. Soon after, the media reported that 38 witnesses watched her murder and did nothing to help. This film follows the efforts of Kitty’s brother to uncover the truth.
